retention_rule: Preserve the smallest owner-bound causal relation that changes future behavior, proof, recovery, or reentry, including what happened and why.
source_rule: Keep operator source, evidence, inference, unknown, invalidator, and supersession distinguishable.
acceptance_rule: Learning from the actual resultant enters the closest owner immediately; optional classifications, wider propagation, assimilation claims, and material effects keep their own evidence or authority boundary.
resultant_rule: A terminal resultant becomes durable through a source-positioned readback that preserves pre-projection correction, actual result, possibility impact, next movement, optional owner-bound learning, effect state, and causal input concurrency.
learning_rule: What happened, its causal delta, why it matters, future behavior, sources, activation relations, invalidator, and reentry become reachable in the next field; later non-identical use remains the assimilation evidence and may revise the relation.
reciprocal_work_rule: Concrete work tests the competence that enables it; causal readback improves the owning relation; the changed relation must alter a later movement to support assimilation.
cultivation_stop_rule: Do not add another competence level when it changes no material relation in comprehension, execution, proof, recovery, or reentry.
